digest.component_or_area: snapshot cache janitor and store population
propositions: The ADR-promised byte-total backstop trigger for store size-driven reclamation was never implemented; _gc_pass reads only disk free space and entry mtime, never consulting the incrementally-maintained byte_total counter.

materialize_tickets bypasses cache.acquire and populates tickets-<sha> entries (~620 MiB each, the store's dominant consumer) without calling add_bytes, so the byte_total counter omits its largest entries.
No configurable cap knob exists in the config surface to bound the snapshot store's own size, leaving only the free-space watermark as a working eviction trigger.
The two gaps are independent root causes: fixing only the backstop still yields an under-counted total; fixing only the accounting still lacks a trigger to fire.
Tests confirm zero evictions occur even when byte_total is forced to 500 GiB with all other triggers disabled, proving the backstop does not exist at any threshold.
